# release-vault
> Encrypted off-site archive (AES-256-CBC/PBKDF2-600k) of release assets from private repos. Filenames are neutralized; manifests are encrypted. Key held only by the owner. Created 2026-11-07.

Автоген 2026-11-08 · источник: живой GitHub API (номера и файлы не руками) · владелец rtynbirf · ветка `main`
